newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on baht, bank worries.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on baht, bank worries.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to continue falling on Thursday on conerns about the weakness of the baht and on figures of non-performing loans of banks due to be released later in the day, brokers said.

"The market sentiment is seen poor today because of the continued weakness of baht this morning. Figures on non-performing loans of banks which are expected to be released later today could also impact the market if they are not good enough," said Payuha Boonsiri of Nithipat Capital.
The composite SET index fell 28.50 points to 631.28 on 7.1 billion baht turnover on Wednesday.

This is the first time that banks are required to detail their non-performing loans to the public. Previously they released their figures to the Stock Exchange of Thailand which then published an average of the sector.
The Thai baht dropped to a new record low of 32.63 per dollar onshore early on Thursday as commercial demand for dollars continued to drive the recently-floated currency lower, dealers said.
